create_segmentation_client: create a SegmentationClient instance that connects to the a0 RPC server on the segmentation topic
run_segment_img: run segment_img on an RGBD image to get object masks and masked RGBD arrays via RPC
build_segmentation_server_subclass: build a SegmentationServer subclass that overrides _get_segmentations to return segmentation labels for an RGBD image
start_segmentation_server: start a SegmentationServer RPC server that listens for segmentation requests and replies with serialized labels
review_segmentation_rpc: review the SegmentationClient and SegmentationServer classes for RPC-based image segmentation using Cap'n Proto serialization
